observations: Yellow manual pallet jack with two forks and black pump handle
2000 stamped on both yellow triangular load backrest plates
Wheels and load rollers visible at fork tips
Visible wear, scuffs, and chipped paint on the frame
Photographed outdoors on a tiled surface near a balustrade

claims.claim: Heavy duty 2.5 Ton manual hydraulic pallet jack
claims.evidence: photo 0 shows 2000 stamped on the fork arms, indicating 2000 kg capacity rather than 2.5 Ton

risks.risk: Hydraulic pump may not lift or hold pressure
risks.proof: video of the handle being pumped with a load on the forks

risks.risk: Wheels and load rollers may be worn or seized
risks.proof: close-up photos of all wheels and rollers turning freely

risks.risk: Frame or welds may be cracked
risks.proof: close-up photos of the frame joints and forks
video or photo showing no fluid residue under the pump after use

proof_requests: Video of the jack lifting and lowering a load
Close-up photos of wheels, rollers, and frame welds
response.reason: The item is clearly a manual pallet jack visible in photo 0, and the 2000 capacity marking contradicts the 2.5 Ton claim, so it can be priced at its worst case while awaiting proof of function.
